$comment: Contract for the AssignCase server-side command (AD-003, AD-040, OD-029, command-concurrency skill). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_AssignCase). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_AssignCase
customApi.description: A team lead or manager allocates a queued case to a named reviewer (BR-003, AD-040). Writes an assignment row, releases the prior one, stamps the review instance in both identity systems and moves the case to Assigned. Enforces command.assign Edit.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase to allocate.

requestParameters.name: AssigneeEmail
requestParameters.description: Work email of the reviewer (OD-003, AD-010). Resolves both the systemuser and the portal contact; the command refuses if either is missing.

requestParameters.name: ReviewInstanceId
requestParameters.description: Which check to allocate. Omit to take the earliest unsubmitted check by sequence, which is the Tax leg then the AQS leg on a Tax-then-AQS route (BR-004).

requestParameters.name: Team
requestParameters.description: Name of the shared queue the case sits in, recorded on the assignment row. Free text; there is no team model (OD-029).

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why this allocation was made. Required in practice for a reassignment (AD-036); recorded on the assignment row and the Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: ExpectedRowVersion
requestParameters.description: Row version of the review instance for optimistic concurrency. Omit to skip the check.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AssignmentId
responseProperties.description: Id of the al_caseassignment row created for this allocation.

responseProperties.name: ReviewInstanceId
responseProperties.description: Id of the review instance that was allocated.

responseProperties.name: Status
responseProperties.description: Assigned, or AlreadyAssigned when an idempotent replay returned the original result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when the command was rejected for an optimistic-concurrency conflict.
